The '''Isiring system''' was located in<ref name="EAOC" /> the [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]]<ref name="CSWE Cassandran">{{CSWECite|I|111|Cassandran Worlds}}</ref> that eventually became the [[Tendrannan sector/Legends|Tendrannan sector]], a [[Sector/Legends|subsector]] of the [[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was situated on the [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which linked it to the [[New Bakstre system/Legends|New Bakstre system]] as well as the [[Vuchelle system/Legends|Vuchelle system]] of the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Isiring system contained a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Isiring|same name]].<ref name="CSWE Isiring" /> Between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the system was situated in the territory of the [[Pentastar Alignment]],<ref name="TEA" /> and it fell within the borders of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] between 12 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Isiring system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-5.<ref name="TEA" />
